en: A black-and-white vintage postcard showing a wide street or public square, lined with multi-story buildings on both sides. In the foreground is a fountain surrounded by trees. In the background, a building with a tower and a prominent clock is visible, possibly a town hall. There are horse-drawn carriages and early automobiles, suggesting a historical period. Some text, possibly in German, is handwritten at the bottom edge.
